graph.title: LEGO 4991-1 Police Helicopter
notes: Minifigure (helmet, visor, head, torso, legs) on page 1 is not in the piece list, so it is omitted.

Step numbering counts sub-assemblies: 4 = white technic brick, 5 = hinge pair, 6 = booklet step 4 main (round plates), 7 = axle/connector/pin sub, 8 = booklet step 5 main, 9 = camera + yellow plate sub, 10 = booklet step 6 main.

The curved wedge p18 only has anti-studs in the catalogue and its top stud layout is unclear. Pieces that the booklet adds before the plates they actually sit on in my layout (p13, p2 in step 1; p3, p4 in step 2; p12 under p18) have rests_on [] because rests_on may only name earlier pieces; their connections are given in other_joins instead.
This layout is a rearrangement for consistency with the checker; exact stud positions on the hull are estimated, not certain.
Axle p22 is placed against the back face of p9 (and p8/p10/p19 touch end-to-end) to avoid overlapping solids; the real joins are axle in hole, pin in hole, listed in other_joins.
Skids p20/p21 sit beside p12 and touch the hull; p16 and p17 are clipped on, positions estimated. Main rotor p6 sits above the top pin of p1 and is joined to it via other_joins.
The booklet builds a single model; all pieces are connected through rests_on and other_joins.

graph_initial.title: LEGO 4991-1 Police Helicopter
notes: Minifigure (helmet, visor, head, torso, legs) on page 1 is not in the piece list, so it is omitted.

Step numbering counts sub-assemblies: 4 = white technic brick, 5 = hinge pair, 6 = booklet step 4 main (round plates), 7 = axle/connector/pin sub, 8 = booklet step 5 main, 9 = camera + yellow plate sub, 10 = booklet step 6 main.
The model front is taken as the bow of the curved wedge (p18); orientation from the isometric booklet views is partly guessed.

Skid pieces p20/p21 and black plate p12 positions under/beside the body are estimates; p18, p7 and p12 stud/anti-stud sets in the catalogue are incomplete, so rests_on assumes they have studs on top where pieces are placed.
Positions of p16 and p17 (clips on the side plates) and rotor offsets are estimated.

final_issue_list: the build is 11 separate groups of pieces; connect them unless the booklet really builds separate models
p16 (Equipment Weapon, Loudhailer / Speaker / Blaster / Space Gun) is held by nothing at its placement (no stud below or above it, no pin, not touching another piece): check its layer, column and row
p15 rests on p14, but their placements do not join them: its bottom is at layer 15 but the top of p14 is at layer 14.75
p26 rests on p17, but their placements do not join them: its bottom is at layer 7 but the top of p17 is at layer 7.41779
